purpose: Offline search aliases for Internet country-code top-level domains (ccTLDs), mapped through the separately reviewed ISO alpha-2 to Factbook crosswalk. Not a sovereignty classification or a live IANA lookup.

source.note: This snapshot contributes only its IANA TLD strings and ISO alpha-2 join keys; its sovereignty/independence fields are not imported.

ianaList.statement: The pinned repository describes itself as a mirror of the IANA TLD list. It is a snapshot, not a live IANA API.
